coordinate_convention.blender: Z up; origin = main-room near-left inner corner at finished floor; +X toward TV wall; +Y toward far door/window
coordinate_convention.gltf_three_js: glTF is Y up (exporter converted): three.x = blender.x, three.y = blender.z, three.z = -blender.y
coordinate_convention.check: room clear width 3.6576 m (X) and length 4.8768 m (-Z in three.js) verified after reimport

walkable_floor: NAV_Walk_Floor (main room + passage polygon); do not allow walking outside it
collider_notes: COL_* boxes carry extras.collider = static | door_closed | door_blocked_unmodelled_room. Hide them in the viewer. Door blockers stay until an open interaction exists; D2 stays blocked because the adjacent room is not modelled. No crystal-level colliders for the jhoomer.

D1.swing: out of main room toward +Y; hinge at smaller X

D2.swing: out of main room toward -X; hinge at smaller Y

D3.swing: out of passage toward +X; hinge at larger Y

jhoomer.note: simplified for web; master has 370 chamfered prisms

lights.notes: glTF carries spot/point lights only. Blender area lights (cove) and world lighting do not export: recreate the cove with RectAreaLights at the HINT_ empties (facing up into the recess) or bake a lightmap; the LED strip is exported as an emissive ring (MW_LED_Cove). Light intensities are converted by the exporter and need re-balancing with tone mapping in three.js.

materials.texture_transform: UVs are in meters; tiling comes from KHR_texture_transform scale (1 / real texture size)
materials.baked: tinted colours and remapped roughness baked with scripts/w00_bake_web_textures.py; procedural 2 ft tile re-made as an image
materials.glass: MW_Crystal uses KHR_materials_transmission; window/picture glass alpha-blended
materials.not_identical: the GLB will not look identical to the Cycles renders (no path tracing, no area lights, simplified crystals)

browser_test: NOT performed in this task - browser performance untested
measurement_status: confirmed: 12x16 ft room, 10 ft structural height; all other geometry proposed estimates
